reviews.title: All good
reviews.text: A short flight on time, professional service, check in process efficient. We wouldn’t hesitate to fly with Kunming Airlines again.
reviews.author: NswAustraliaDidi

reviews.title: The flight was fine, on time, and the service staff courteous and accommodating.
reviews.text: Although the flights themselves were comfortable and timely, I had a very bad experience at the airport in Xiamen. I went to inquire about how to get into the city--since unlike most Chinese cities there was no subway connection, nor "bashi" busses from the airport to different parts of the city--and the next thing I knew I was in a limousine on my way to the hotel for 70 Yuan! I found out from others who had come into the airport that if I had simply walked outside to a cab driver, my fare would have been half of that cost. Beware of the rip off "taxi inquiry desk!"
reviews.author: Judi M
